content.text: Lead your favourite team to Title!The Ultimate Cricket Simulation GameBuild your squad. Dominate the league. Win the championship.Realistic Match SimulationFull Squad ManagementSeason CampaignsCricket Director In ActionA glimpse into your cricket management journey.Squad ManagementView your full roster with batting, bowling, and fielding ratings for every playerThe ultimate cricket management experience, right in your browser.The Ultimate Cricket Management ExperienceAbout the DeveloperHey! I'm Dhiva, 25 - a solo founder and bootstrapper from Tamil Nadu, India who builds SaaS startups. I quit my job at Zoho in July 2025 to go full-time indie.My main focus is AITuber.app - an AI video creator with 500+ voices, helping content creators earn passive income and product marketers scale their video content effortlessly.Cricket Director is my long-time dream - a Football Manager-style game but for cricket. I built this on the side because I just had to make it exist. I'm not sure what the future holds since it's not my main focus, but I'll keep adding updates whenever I find time.But when I'm financially free enough, I might focus more on this. My dream is to retire with a big corpus, no pressure to do things, and just keep developing and playing games like this. Let's see where this journey goes!Got feedback or found a bug?DM me on X or connect on LinkedIn. I read every message and love hearing from players!Note: Player names are used for simulation purposes only. If any player or organization has concerns, please reach out - we'll happily make changes.DisclaimerCricket Director is an independent simulation game created for entertainment purposes. Player names, team names, and likenesses are used solely for realistic gameplay simulation. This game is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the BCCI, ICC, IPL, or any cricket board or organization. If you are a rights holder and have concerns about the use of any names or likenesses, please contact us. We're a small passion project and will gladly work with you to resolve any issues.
